title: THE FIRST POLE
why: Six races into a Formula 1 career, on a circuit where the wall ends the lap, against the reigning double world champion in identical machinery.

title: MONACO, SATURDAY
why: The lap that has to be built corner by corner over three sectors with no margin in any of them.

title: THE SINGAPORE LAP
why: Six tenths clear on a circuit where the car was not the fastest. Hamilton called it his best qualifying lap; the telemetry shows where it came from.

title: FIFTY LAPS ON ONE SET
why: A championship-winning stint managed by tyre temperature rather than lap time. Watch the throttle traces, not the speed.

title: TENTH TO FIRST
why: Twenty-five overtakes across two days with an engine advantage on the straights and nothing at all in the corners.

title: THE LAST LAP
why: Fifty-seven laps of control and one lap of everything else. The delta trace is the whole 2021 season in a single chart.

title: THE NINTH AT HOME
why: Three changes of tyre compound in changing conditions, and the last one called correctly.

title: THE 106TH
why: A first Ferrari Grand Prix win, 66 laps, +19.561s. The most recent lap in this archive, and not the last.
